title: TTC Westel
description: These Figma prototypes were created for the website of the table tennis club in Westerlo. It was developed during the first semester of the Applied Computer Science bachelor program for the course Skills Integration Lab 2. The project includes a full prototype designed in Figma and later developed into a functional website by another team. This project was a team project where I worked with 4 other students. Below, I will show different pages of the application prototypes that I created or helped creating with a teammember.

pageDetails.title: Sign page for season
pageDetails.description: Every season, players of the club have to sign a seasonal contract. Without this they cannot attend lessons or play in tournaments.

pageDetails.title: Competition page
pageDetails.description: All played competition need to be added to the website. The managers & admins can add a competition matches here.

pageDetails.title: Register trainings page
pageDetails.description: Players need to train for their competition matches. On this page, a training can register slots for trainings, which players can later choose from.
pageDetails.imageAlt: TTC Westel register training slots page

pageDetails.title: Live score page
pageDetails.description: During a competition, players can see the live score of the competition. Club leaders can enter the live score of the competition here.

pageDetails.title: Manage materials page
pageDetails.description: A player can upload materials for their training here. The materials will be bought by the trainer or club leader and delivered to the players before the due date.

techStackDetails.title: Figma
techStackDetails.description: The project started with a full Figma prototype, which defined the layout, interactions, and user flow.

conclusion: My goal is to be a frontend developer in the future. To build an application, having prototypes of the application is very important. Having a prototype allows me to see how the application will look like, and how it will work. It makes it easier to present a possible layout to the client, and make changes quick. Figma is used a lot to make prototypes, so this project really helped me master my Figma skills and make me a better frontend developer.
